_spec_ref: PROJECT_META v3, Teil B.1-B.3. Every assumption carries an explicit legal_status.

legal_status_vocabulary.VERIFIED: Checked against primary legal source; citation recorded.
legal_status_vocabulary.TO_BE_VERIFIED: Modelled assumption, plausible, NOT yet checked against primary source. Blocks promotion above MODEL_CONSISTENT_FINDING for any claim it materially drives.
legal_status_vocabulary.NOT_IN_DECISION_PATH: Implemented and tested, but not exercised by any decision-path run. Must not gate.

abgeltungsteuer.assumption_note: 25% Abgeltungsteuer (§32d Abs.1 EStG) plus 5.5% Solidaritaetszuschlag on the tax amount. Soli is modelled as fully applicable to Kapitalertragsteuer (the 2021 Soli reduction does not extend to Abgeltungsteuer).

church_tax.formula: est = (kapitalertrag - 4*q) / (4 + k_percent); total = est * (1 + soli + k)
church_tax.assumption_note: §32d Abs.1 S.4-5 EStG. With q=0 and k=9%: effective 27.9951%. Sensitivity only per A.4; baseline is none.

teilfreistellung.assumption_note: §20 InvStG: 30% partial exemption for private investors in equity funds (>=51% equity). Applied to both Vorabpauschale and realised gains.

vorabpauschale.assumption_note: §18 InvStG (Basisertrag = NAV_start_of_year * 0.7 * Basiszins, capped at the Wertsteigerung of the year, floored at 0, reduced by 1/12 per full month preceding the acquisition month) and §19 InvStG (accumulated Vorabpauschalen reduce the gain on disposal, preventing double taxation). An ETC is a debt security, not an Investmentfonds, so no Vorabpauschale applies to GOLD under either tax variant.

basiszins.assumption_note: Assumption, to be checked against the annual BMF-Schreiben: 2023 ~2.55%, 2024 ~2.29%, 2025 ~2.53%, 2021/2022 negative -> floored to 0. The Basiszins is derived from the yield of long-dated German government bonds and is published at the start of each calendar year. Coupled to the modelled short rate so that an inflation regime cannot occur without a corresponding rise in the Basiszins (B.2 rationale: a deterministic Basiszins systematically understates the tax burden in inflationary worlds).

freistellungsauftrag.assumption_note: Sparer-Pauschbetrag §20 Abs.9 EStG, 1000 EUR since 2023 (single filer). Modelled as nominally constant over the whole horizon - NOT indexed to inflation. This is a conservative, explicitly stated modelling choice: in a high-inflation world the real value of the FSA decays.

withholding_tax_credit.rationale: Accumulating Irish funds suffer foreign withholding tax at fund level; it is not creditable for the German private investor, and the Teilfreistellung is the statutory compensation mechanism. After DIVIDEND was reclassified to equity_fund, the universe contains no direct_stocks instrument, so no decision-path run exercises this branch.
withholding_tax_credit.action: Code and hand-checks are retained and still execute in the test suite, but are DECOUPLED from every gate. No gate may depend on this branch.
withholding_tax_credit.known_v2_defect: The v2 implementation applied credit = min(swht, dt) against 26.375% rather than against 25% Einkommensteuer with Solidaritaetszuschlag applied afterwards. This is the defect that held R2 at FAIL_LEGAL_EXACTNESS. It is corrected in the retained code, but the correction is NOT a decision-path claim.

etc_debt_security_B3_assumed.assumption_note: IE00B4ND3602 is an Irish debt security (ETC) without a physical delivery claim. Assumed fully taxable under §20 EStG: no Teilfreistellung, no holding-period exemption. Effective ~26.375% on the gain.

etc_debt_security_B3_alternative.assumption_note: Contrast variant reflecting BFH case law on §23 EStG private disposal transactions: tax-free after a one-year holding period. That case law concerns deliverable domestic constructions (Xetra-Gold), NOT this product. Computed only because B.3 requires both variants to be reported while legal_status != VERIFIED.

b3_dual_reporting.rule: While assets_tax_classes.etc_debt_security_B3_assumed.legal_status != VERIFIED, every GOLD claim MUST be computed and reported under BOTH variants. A single-variant GOLD result is not a valid deliverable.
b3_dual_reporting.materiality: ~26% on the gain versus 0% (alternative) - decides the GOLD claim on its own.
